edits.old: - No build dependency: this story is Day 1 by rule (Template and Rules §R5.7), because every build dependency of its patterns arrives with the platform contract libraries and the baseline of this service.
edits.new:
- No build dependency: this story is Day 1 by rule (Template and Rules §R5.7), because every build dependency of its patterns arrives with the platform contract libraries and the baseline of this service.
- A restore of the store is promoted only after the chain re-verification and the append-only check pass. The recovery point objective for committed entries is zero, through the point-in-time recovery of the ACE database and the seal files. The recovery time objective is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1234).
- A decision committed in the owning service and not yet in the central ledger is not shown as sealed. The central audit search (`rwb-decision`) reads the ledger only and shows the entry as not yet sealed until JOB-13 has collected it. The local record is reached through the owning service's contract. Strict mode waits for the ledger acknowledgement of its own record, and the wait bound is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1617).
